_comment: SHA-256 of every file vcpkg installs, from a trusted from-source build under the deterministic triplet x64-windows-repro. Regenerate ONLY from a build with the binary cache disabled. See tools/gate/vcpkg_cache_manifest.py.
toolchain_note: Identifies the toolchain that produced these bytes. A byte-pinning manifest cannot be immune to a compiler change -- new codegen means new bytes, which SHOULD be re-reviewed -- so this field exists to make that the FIRST thing --verify says, instead of an undifferentiated wall of CONTENTS CHANGED.
unpinned_note: 274 file(s) are deliberately NOT content-verified; see docs/security/vcpkg-cache-unpinned.json for the per-file reason. They are still required to be PRESENT.
